links.outcome: Whether LLM pain recommendations change when patient demographic attributes in prompts are varied
links.effect: Race, language, and socioeconomic status often did not alter recommendations; opioid use disorder history consistently changed suggestions (opioid-sparing). Overall agreement 82% for ED medications, 78% for discharge medications.
links.quote: When using cGPT, demographic factors such as race, language, and socioeconomic status often did not alter recommendations.

screen.reason: Empirical study testing ChatGPT-4 for demographic bias across simulated clinical pain management scenarios without testing a specific operational guardrail or deployment intervention.
